name: Lentil Shepherd's Pie
ingredients: ½ cup (100 g) brown or green lentils, rinsed
1 tsp dried thyme and 1 tsp soy sauce
Topping: 150 g potatoes and 300 g cauliflower, boiled, mashed with ¼ cup unsweetened soy milk
steps: Simmer the lentils in the stock for 20 minutes until almost tender.
Heat the oil and cook the onion, carrot and mushrooms for 8 minutes. Add garlic, tomato paste, thyme and soy sauce.
Stir in the lentils with their stock and the peas. Simmer for 8 minutes until thick.
Mash the potato and cauliflower with the soy milk, salt and pepper.
Spread the lentil mix in a baking dish, top with the mash, and bake at 200°C for 20 minutes until lightly golden.
note: A hearty plant-based version of the British classic; replacing part of the potato with cauliflower reduces the carbohydrate load.
